_comment: Region-specific pain points and personas (ids prefixed in_/eu_/us_). Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order, within the document's region).

categories.name: UPI payments failing or pending
categories.description: UPI debited but not credited, pending for hours, bank servers down.

categories.name: UPI, OTP & KYC scams
categories.description: Collect-request scams, fake KYC calls, digital-arrest frauds.

categories.name: Accounts frozen by cyber cell / lien
categories.description: Accounts frozen or liened after receiving disputed UPI money.

categories.name: Re-KYC, Aadhaar & PAN hassles
categories.description: Repeated re-KYC, branch visits, Aadhaar/PAN linking.

categories.name: Minimum balance & hidden charges
categories.description: Non-maintenance, SMS, debit-card and ATM charges.
keywords: minimum balance|non-?maintenance|sms charges|debit card (charges|annual fee)|atm (charges|fee)|hidden charges|charges deducted

categories.name: Credit card fees, late charges & devaluation
categories.description: Annual fees, late-payment charges, reward devaluations, limit cuts.

categories.name: Bank app & net banking downtime
categories.description: YONO/iMobile/net banking down, OTP not arriving.

categories.name: Branch service & complaints
categories.description: Long queues, staff sending customers away, ombudsman complaints.

categories.name: Digital bank account freezes (Monzo, Revolut, N26)
categories.description: Accounts frozen for reviews with no timeline or explanation.

categories.name: Scam losses & APP reimbursement
categories.description: Authorised push-payment scams, safe-account scams, refusals to refund.

categories.name: Account closures & debanking
categories.description: Banks closing accounts with 60 days' notice and no reason.
keywords: account closed|closing my account|debank|60 days notice|exit(ed)? (me|customer)

categories.name: Faster Payments / SEPA transfer delays
categories.description: Payments held for checks, SEPA delays, international transfers.
keywords: faster payment|sepa|bank transfer.{0,20}(delay|pending|held|not arrived)|swift|international transfer|payment held

categories.name: Overdraft rates & fees
categories.description: Arranged overdraft rates near 40% APR, unexpected fees.

categories.name: Branch closures & cash access
categories.description: Local branches and ATMs closing, harder to deposit cash.
keywords: branch (closure|closing|closed)|nearest branch|deposit cash|cash machine|post office banking|atm (closed|removed)

categories.name: Verification, 2FA & ID checks
categories.description: Strong customer authentication failures, phone changes, ID verification loops.
keywords: verification|verify (my )?identity|\b2fa\b|strong customer authentication|new phone|card reader|id check

categories.name: Card declines & blocks
categories.description: Cards declined abroad or blocked by fraud systems.

categories.name: Zelle & P2P scams
categories.description: Zelle, Venmo and Cash App scams; banks refusing reimbursement.

categories.name: Overdraft & NSF fees
categories.description: Overdraft fees, NSF charges, fee reordering.

categories.name: Accounts closed without explanation
categories.description: Chase, Wells Fargo and others closing accounts suddenly.
keywords: (chase|wells fargo|bank of america|capital one|citi|td bank).{0,30}(closed|closing|froze|frozen|locked)|account closed|closed my account

categories.name: Check, mobile-deposit & wire holds
categories.description: Funds held for days, mobile deposits rejected, wires delayed.
keywords: hold on (my )?(check|deposit)|mobile deposit|check hold|funds (on hold|not available)|wire (transfer )?(delay|pending)|\bach\b

categories.name: Card disputes & chargebacks
categories.description: Fraud claims and merchant disputes denied.

categories.name: Fraud alerts & locked accounts
categories.description: Accounts or cards locked for suspected fraud; verification loops.

categories.name: ATM fees & branch access
categories.description: Out-of-network ATM fees, branch closures.

categories.name: Low savings interest
categories.description: Big banks paying near-zero APY.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.name: UPI merchant / shopkeeper
personas.description: Takes UPI payments via QR and soundbox.

personas.name: Digital-bank customer
personas.description: Uses Monzo, Revolut, N26 or Starling.

personas.name: Expat / migrant
personas.description: New arrival needing an account and transfers home.
keywords: expat|moved to|new to the uk|immigrant|visa|send money home

personas.name: Sole trader
personas.description: Uses personal or business accounts for trade.
